summary.motive: Force the perimeter force player into an instantaneous declare so the pitch punishes any aggressive trigger.
summary.whyItWorks: The arc plus pitch-track spacing makes the quarterback pitchable only when the corner commits upfield, converting his aggression directly into a numbers advantage.
summary.failureMode: The corner squeezes and stays square, keeping both phases alive until help arrives over the top of the option.

beats.title: 1. The Arc and Flow
beats.text: The quarterback arcs flat off the pistol mesh while the slot sprints across to get ahead of the ball — the entire defense starts flowing to its right.

beats.title: 2. Force Declares
beats.text: The pitch track puts F even with the arc as both men read one defender: the force corner. Whatever he does next decides the football.

beats.title: 3. Pitch on the Trigger
beats.text: The corner triggers upfield hunting the quarterback — exactly the cue that makes him pitchable. The ball goes out with F already at full speed.

beats.title: 4. Perimeter Finish
beats.text: The safety arrives a beat late and gets led-on by the crossing slot while F turns north at full stride behind the displaced force.

relations.tell: The quarterback never rides a mesh before arcing — every other pistol run seats the ball for at least a full step.
